title: Maikura Stack Expansion
description: Configurable stack limits and potion duration accumulation for Minecraft Fabric.
body:
# Maikura Stack Expansion

Expand stack sizes and potion duration limits with fully configurable category-based settings.

## Features

* Configurable stack limits by item category
* Block items up to 1024
* Materials up to 512
* Mob drops up to 512
* Food items up to 256
* Potions up to 64
* Enchanted books up to 64
* Support for special item limits
* Potion duration accumulation support
* Mod Menu integration
* Japanese configuration GUI

## Default Settings

| Category        | Default Limit |
| --------------- | ------------- |
| Blocks          | 1024          |
| Materials       | 512           |
| Mob Drops       | 512           |
| Food            | 256           |
| Potions         | 64            |
| Enchanted Books | 64            |
| 16-Stack Items  | 128           |
| Special Items   | 16            |

Potion duration accumulation limit:

* 60 minutes

## Configuration

All settings can be changed through Mod Menu.

You can customize stack limits for each supported category and adjust the maximum accumulated potion duration.

## Known Issues

When combining stacked enchanted books in an anvil, Minecraft may only produce a single output book and consume the remaining books in the stack.

To avoid this issue, split enchanted books into individual stacks before using an anvil.

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Mod Menu (optional)
